physicalNotes: Radius 0.82 +/- 0.017 solar radii from Persson et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1438 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..69P/abstract): 570,474 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.876 +/- 0.038 solar masses from Persson et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1438 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..69P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5230 +/- 60 K from Persson et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1438 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A..69P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
